//: Port of this folder's denver.yml to devbox. Written to spec and NOT
denver original: a single 'uv' stage -- a virtualenv with two pinned
devbox has no first-class venv concept the way devenv and mise do, so
creating and activating it is init_hook shell script -- closer to the
hand-rolled system_venv.sh that denver's uv provider was written to
replace than to the provider itself.
GAP -- denver fingerprinted requirements.txt and re-installed only when
it changed. The `uv pip install` below runs on every shell entry. uv
makes that cheap, but it is not the same guarantee.
